item.title: Coca-Cola brings back Rimzim Jeera with RD Burman classic
item.description: Coca-Cola India has brought back Rimzim Jeera, a brand originally introduced by Parle in the 1980s and later acquired by The Coca-Cola Company in 1993. The beverage was discontinued in the early 2000s as the company shifted focus to other labels in its portfolio. The relaunch comes amid renewed consumer interest in local flavours and the rise of regional players in the jeera-based beverage category. item.title: The Campbell’s Company names Mohit Anand as president of snacks division
item.description: The Campbell’s Company (Campbell’s) has announced the appointment of Mohit Anand as executive vice president (EVP) and president, snacks, effective Feb. 23, 2026. He will lead a portfolio of advantaged snack brands including Goldfish, Pepperidge Farm, Snyder’s of Hanover, Lance, Kettle Brand, Cape Cod, Snack Factory and Late July. item.title: Meta to retire standalone Messenger website this April
item.description: Meta has announced that it will discontinue its dedicated Messenger web portal, messenger.com, in April 2026. This move follows the recent retirement of the Messenger desktop applications for Windows and Mac, effectively ending standalone desktop access for the service. Once the change takes effect, users visiting the site will be automatically redirected to the messaging interface within the main Facebook platform.
